message: **National Address Database (NAD)** – New quarterly release available. Address coverage updates for 12 states. [Learn more](https://www.transportation.gov/grants/nad).
**Census Bureau** – API discovery and data releases updated. Request a [free API key](https://api.census.gov/data/key_signup.html) for higher limits.
**Overture Maps Foundation** – Places and buildings APIs in production. Open, community-built base map data for the Americas and worldwide.
